overall_design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for HHL-5 cells (ZBED3-OE) treated with FFAs.
summary: To investigate the regulatory function of ZBED3 in NAFLD, we established a ZBED3-overexpressing HHL-5 cell line treated with FFAs.
We then performed gene expression profiling using RNA-seq data from 2 different cells treated with the same concentration of FFAs.
title: Effect of overexpression of ZBED3 on gene expression in HHL-5 hepatocytes
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
